description.value: Body Energy Club is a Vancouver-born health food and supplement retailer founded in 2002 in a humble 500-square-foot Davie Street shop, now grown into a multi-location chain spanning Vancouver, the Lower Mainland, and US cities. Each location combines a retail supplement floor with a smoothie and bowl bar, stocking everything from creatine and protein to energy gels, electrolytes, cold-pressed juices, and vitamins. It has also expanded into one of Canada's largest online vitamin and supplement retailers, with in-store pickup available in about 30 minutes via app.
